tasks.label: swift: Run Tests
tasks.command: if [ -d /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/Library/Developer/Frameworks/Testing.framework ] && [ ! -d /Applications/Xcode.app ]; then swift test -Xswiftc -F/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/Library/Developer/Frameworks -Xlinker -F/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/Library/Developer/Frameworks -Xlinker -framework -Xlinker Testing -Xlinker -rpath -Xlinker /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/Library/Developer/Frameworks; else swift test; fi
